title: Prove portable guidance without copying private operations
text: Public product teaching now has nested canonical homes under docs/public, including agent operation rules, machine authorization, GitHub scope, shared files and verification. The source-only teaching model stays outside the install bundle. Private topology, operator state, fresh private pointer inventory and rollback evidence remain private and unproved here. Global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance, combined global sizing and actual global receiving captures moved to YOK-3975 and remain required there. No private source absence or ownership transfer counts as successful delivery.
